Former CJI Chandrachud appointed as arbitrator in Russia-Ukraine bank dispute

Former Chief Justice of India D.Y. Chandrachud has been appointed as Russia's arbitrator in a dispute with Ukraine's Oschadbank. The arbitration concerns Oschadbank's claims over lost assets in four regions, stemming from Russian military actions. This follows an earlier Crimea-related arbitration. The case involves a three-member international tribunal and is reportedly for hundreds of millions of dollars.
